thread:
jordan: Quick async check-in — gateway/routing/auth/rate-limits

jordan: Yesterday: finished the route policy validation for tenant-shard routing and landed the schema change (PR #4823).
jordan: Blockers: canary in eu-west seeing a small bump in 95p tail latency and ~2% more 429s for thinburst jobs. investigating whether batching change or token-bucket config is the culprit.
jordan: Today: iterate on rate config, run a short canary rollback if needed, and open a follow-up to tune batching heuristics.

mira: Thanks — can you paste the canary link and which service/job is 429ing?
mira: I can pair on the jwt rotation test that's been flaky in CI after lunch.

jordan: Canary grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/inked/canary-eu-west?panelId=3 (TL;DR: ingress gateway -> thinburst queue). 429s are concentrated on /v1/generate with long-seq requests.

su: Quick thought — token bucket burst_size was bumped in the policy change to 5x. lowering it reduced concurrency for short bursts but might cause queueing for steady long seqs.
su: Short config snippet I tested locally:```yaml
rate_limit:
  requests_per_minute: 600
  burst: 120
  refill_interval_ms: 1000
```
su: With burst=120 the 429s disappeared in my load run. Could we try a canary with that?

raj: I can scope logs and open a quick dashboard with traces. ping me the exact timeframe and I'll drop spans into the canary board.

deploy-bot: deploy: PR #4823 -> staging succeeded (2024-06-14T11:18:03Z) :tada:

mira: Blocker for me: CI job `jwt-rotate-integ` flakes when run in parallel with `auth-cache-clean`. thinking to serialize those in CI stage. if someone else hits it, we should queue them.
su: Workaround: add `--ci-serialize-auth-tests` to the job for now. command: `./scripts/ci-run --jobs 1 --filter auth`
su: I'll open a tiny PR to update the CI job definition and add a comment explaining the race.
mira: Awesome, thanks — will pair after I finish a doc review.

jordan: OK I'll kick a canary with burst=120 in eu-west for 30m, and handoff to @raj to watch traces. if 429s don't recur we'll merge the burst change and roll forward.

raj: Got it — I'll watch the 95p latency and error budget. will post an update in this thread.

jordan: Sweet. thanks everyone. ping here if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:

raj: quick FYI — if we need to rollback, PR #4818 is the previous policy snapshot.

mira: noted, will queue the CI change after the canary.

jordan: End of async — short follow-ups: (1) raj watches canary, (2) su opens CI & config PRs, (3) mira pairs on jwt test later.
